name: QueryExcelWorksheet
label: Query Excel Worksheet
discription: Executes a SQL query on an Excel worksheet and returns the result as a DataTable.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: Excel File Path
fields.description: Full path of the Excel file (.xls or .xlsx).

fields.name: SqlQuery
fields.label: SQL Query
fields.description: SQL query to execute. Example: SELECT * FROM [Sheet1$] WHERE Salary > 50000

fields.name: FirstRowAsHeader
fields.label: First Row As Header
fields.description: Specify whether first row contains column headers.
